limits: Technical-only proxy, not exact A/B/C/V5 and chip/revenue. Stocks sampled from current survivors; 0050/2327 known 2025 splits normalized; other corporate actions unresolved. No slippage/limit-up inability/real portfolio capital overlap, no dividends. Exact day-close observation then next-open action, capital budget=1 including idle cash. Winning trades counted if net capital return >0; partial exits 1/3 on +20% remaining position weighted book cost; 30-trading-day max.

parameters.MA20_exit: 3 consecutive closes below MA20, next open
parameters.day3_failure: on day3, close below MA10 and either below signal low or >=3.5% under initial buy open
parameters.day5_weak: on day5, close below entry open and 2 consecutive closes below MA10; reduce half next open or exit depending on scenario
parameters.day3_add: day3 strong green, closes above MA10/MA20, MA20 slope up, less than 5% MA20 extension, >=0.8 average volume, closes above prior setup+2-day highs; next open add remaining 25% cash
parameters.day5_add: day5 green, closes above MA10/MA20, MA20 rising, <5% extension, >=0.8 avg vol, closes above four preceding days highs; next open add remaining 25% cash
parameters.initial_cash_split: baseline_full starts 100% bought; add scenario starts 75%, keeps 25% cash reserved. Compare baseline_75cash25 to added strategies for equal starting deployment.
